# Atlantis NDT — Full Context for AI Crawlers

> Founder-led non-destructive testing (NDT) company: inspection services, ASNT SNT-TC-1A training, outsourced ASNT Level III consulting, and inspection software. Offices in Houston, Texas and Hyderabad, India; work is delivered remotely, online, or on-site at the client's facility.

This file follows the llmstxt.org format. It states only facts Atlantis NDT stands behind; where a page on https://atlantisndt.com goes into more detail, it is linked. Last reviewed 2026-10-18.

---

## About Atlantis NDT

Atlantis NDT (Atlantis Engineering Consultants LLC) is founded and led by Anoop Rayavarapu, ASNT NDT Level III in five methods (UT, RT, MT, PT, VT) with 11+ years of international NDT field experience. NAS 410 Level 3 services are provided through an associate who holds NAS 410 Level 3. The company has offices in Houston, Texas and Hyderabad, India, and works for operators, fabricators, EPCs and inspection companies in oil and gas, petrochemical, aerospace, marine, power generation and manufacturing.

- [About](https://atlantisndt.com/about)
- [Contact](https://atlantisndt.com/contact)

---

## NDT Training

- ASNT SNT-TC-1A Level I and Level II courses in UT, RT, MT, PT, VT and ET, plus PAUT and TOFD; ASNT NDT Level III exam preparation.
- Courses are 100% online and self-paced, built to ASNT SNT-TC-1A and ASNT CP-105: recorded video lectures, practical videos, PDF study notes, quizzes, mock tests and a question bank, the 3D Practical NDT simulator (included at no extra cost) and guidance from an ASNT NDT Level III. Portal access is valid for one year and enrolment is open all year.
- The General, Specific and Practical examinations are administered by Atlantis's Level III; the practical can be administered online over a video call. In-person hands-on training at the employer's facility is available on request. Atlantis NDT has no training centre or classroom.
- A course gives documented training hours; it does not certify anyone. Under SNT-TC-1A the employer certifies, under its written practice. ASNT also runs central ASNT NDT Level II (MT, PT, RT, UT, VT) and Level III programmes.
- Canada: courses train to ASNT SNT-TC-1A. Work that names CAN/CGSB-48.9712 needs certification from NRCan or CWB Group, with training from one of their Recognized Training Organizations, which Atlantis NDT is not.
- Training fees are published on the training pages for the USA, the Middle East, Europe and South East Asia. Registration and payment are on the Atlantis portal (https://portal.atlantisndt.com), which shows the fee for the visitor's country.

Pages: [Training](https://atlantisndt.com/training) · [Training FAQ](https://atlantisndt.com/ndt-training-faq) · [SNT-TC-1A eligibility checker](https://atlantisndt.com/snt-tc-1a-eligibility) · [Training USA](https://atlantisndt.com/training-usa) · [Level 1](https://atlantisndt.com/ndt-level-1-training) · [Level 2](https://atlantisndt.com/ndt-level-2-training) · [ASNT Level III](https://atlantisndt.com/asnt-level-iii-training) · [Online](https://atlantisndt.com/ndt-training-online) · [Practice tests](https://atlantisndt.com/ndt-practice-tests)

## ASNT Level III Consulting

Outsourced Level III support for inspection companies and asset owners: SNT-TC-1A written practices, NDT procedures and their review, Level III examinations under the employer's written practice, certification programme set-up, and audit support. Delivered remotely or on-site.

Pages: [Level III consulting](https://atlantisndt.com/consulting/ndt-consulting-level-iii) · [Consulting](https://atlantisndt.com/consulting) · [Written practice development](https://atlantisndt.com/ndt-written-practice-development) · [Free written practice template](https://atlantisndt.com/resources/ndt-written-practice-template)

---

## Inspection Services

Field inspection in UT, PAUT, TOFD, RT, MT, PT and VT, with reports reviewed by a Level III; API 510, 570 and 653 inspection programme support. Technicians are mobilised to the client's site anywhere in the USA; apart from the Houston office there is no local office, so mobilisation is planned and quoted for each job.

Pages: [Inspection services](https://atlantisndt.com/inspection-services) · [Ultrasonic testing](https://atlantisndt.com/ultrasonic-testing) · [Phased array inspection](https://atlantisndt.com/inspection/phased-array-inspection-services) · [Weld inspection](https://atlantisndt.com/weld-inspection)

---

## Software

### Atlantis ERP
Business management for inspection companies: technician certifications and their status, equipment calibration, jobs, quoting, invoicing and NDT reports in one system. A free trial is available. Ten integrations are listed on the integration matrix. Plans for the USA and Canada are published on the ERP pricing page; elsewhere ERP is quoted on request. The ERP does not calculate corrosion rates, inspection intervals, risk-based inspection or fitness-for-service.

Pages: [ERP](https://atlantisndt.com/erp) · [Free trial](https://atlantisndt.com/free-trial) · [Integration matrix](https://atlantisndt.com/ndt-erp-integration-matrix) · [NDT inspection software](https://atlantisndt.com/ndt-inspection-software) · [NDT reporting software comparison](https://atlantisndt.com/best-ndt-reporting-software-2026)

### Digital Twin Reporting
Inspection history on a navigable 3D model of the asset. The public page shows a labelled sample report.

Page: [Digital Twin Reporting](https://atlantisndt.com/digital-twin-reporting)

### Practical NDT
A browser-based 3D practical NDT simulator: 12 method families in 12 workplaces, 33 practical lessons and 473 jobs. A twelve-step evaluator credits only evidence the simulation has recorded; interpretation is reviewed by the instructor, not scored by software. It runs on desktop, touch and headset, and is integrated with the Atlantis LMS and the Atlantis ERP. A simulator does not replace supervised work on real equipment.

Pages: [Practical NDT](https://atlantisndt.com/practical-ndt) · [UT practical simulator](https://atlantisndt.com/practical-ndt/ultrasonic-testing-simulator) · [Free A-scan simulator](https://atlantisndt.com/tools/ultrasonic-a-scan-simulator)

### 3D Scanning
LiDAR, photogrammetry and drone capture for as-built models of plants, tanks and structures. A scan records surfaces; wall thickness and cracks need NDT.

Page: [3D scanning services](https://atlantisndt.com/3d-scanning-services)

## Pricing

Atlantis NDT does not publish prices except: training fees for the USA, the Middle East, Europe and South East Asia (on those training pages; the Atlantis portal shows each country's fee at registration) and ERP plans for the USA and Canada (on the ERP pricing page). Everything else — consulting, inspection, Digital Twin Reporting, Practical NDT, reporting software, custom work — is quoted on request.
